messages.text: The generated set now covers cinematic photography, ink art, beauty portraiture, graphic design, illustration, product imagery, automotive work, and watercolor, with the 2026 contemporary period verified in each prompt and all eight files inspected as a contact sheet. I’m wiring those local assets into the route surfaces and implementing the interaction states next: the storefront keeps source-like overlays and lightbox behavior, while dedicated detail, cart/checkout, and analytics routes provide the complete product flow behind it.
